title: Story cards
summary: The story arrives as cards. Most wait for you; some ask you to choose.
text:
As the colony grows, things happen: a find out in the world, a message, a colonist with something on their mind. Each arrives as a **story card**.

Most cards don't stop the game: they wait their turn, one at a time, until you've read them. A few big moments pause the game while they're open.

- A card with several speakers is a conversation: tap **Next** for each line
- A card with **choices** asks you to decide. Choose with care: what you pick is remembered, and some choices only show what they cost much later
- A card with no choice just has Continue

Radio messages come in their own corner panel and close by themselves; they stay in the log.
